Hello, knD-sensei. Nice to meet you! I apologize for bothering you during your busy schedule, but I'm a huge fan of your work, and the atmosphere of your characters is truly unique. I'd like to ask if you could draw an illustration of my OC. Below are the settings for the two OCs. Their relationship is employer and employee.

Nishinomiya Ritsu (179cm) A 25-year-old black-haired man. He inherited a pirate crew disguised as a maritime theater troupe and became its new troupe leader. While nominally touring the seas as a theater company, their true purpose is treasure hunting. During one such expedition, he was discovered by Yasukawa Sei, a newly emerged pirate. Nishinomiya used a map as leverage to coerce Yasukawa into joining his crew. Beyond his pirate duties, Nishimiya also has him perform on stage alongside him, holding Yasukawa in high regard. As both troupe leader and pirate captain, Nishimiya excels in both acting and combat, but is extremely clumsy emotionally. He carefully tries to create "romantic moments" like in dramas for Yasukawa, who he is gradually growing fond of, but so far to no effect, leaving him still in unrequited love. Yasukawa Sei (175cm)
A 27-year-old man with brown hair. An adventurer who set sail driven by a passion for treasure hunting, eventually becoming a pirate. However, shortly after setting sail, he encountered a troublesome opponent. Learning that Nishimiya possessed the treasure map he'd long dreamed of, he reluctantly joined his pirate crew. His goal is to steal the map and escape safely. Yasukawa is energetic and kind-hearted, but he's harbored resentment towards Nishimiya's threatening attitude from the start. When he discovered the boss harbored feelings for him, he was shocked and refused to acknowledge it. Consequently, he ignores all advances from Nishimiya, though he handles business matters properly. I'd love to see interactions between this ill-matched CP. I would appreciate it if you could draw it using the image at the link below as a reference. If the price isn't sufficient, I can increase it. Usage: Personal. Thank you again for taking the time to look at this despite your busy schedule. Have a great day!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ZBQXhKx_tkG8TIN4A3r2b-98wFgF3g9F

KnD先生、こんにちは。
前回の作品が本当に素晴らしくて、とても嬉しかったです！
ぜひ今回も新しいご依頼をお願いしたいと思いました。

■ キャラクター紹介
どちらもヨーロッパ出身の男性です。

● 金髪
20歳前後、短髪。大学のジャーナリズム学科を卒業したばかりで、黒髪記者の助手。
明るく穏やかそうに見えて、実は執着心が強く、愛や理想のためなら過激な行動も辞さないタイプ。
黒髪を「自分の英雄」として崇拝し、独りよがりな好意を押し付けることも。
傷つけられても、それを愛情の証として受け止めてしまいます。

● 黒髪
26歳の記者。無表情で口数が少なく、仕事に真面目。喫煙の習慣あり。
金髪の能力を高く評価し感謝しているが、その情熱的で独断的な性格には困っている。
金髪を信頼できる後輩・弟のように思っているが、時に暴力的に“正したくなる”衝動を隠しています。

■ 関係性
金髪 → 黒髪：世界で一番好き！ずっと一緒にいたい！
黒髪 → 金髪：手のかかる後輩だが、責任を取らなければ。

■ 依頼内容
舞台は20世紀の架空ヨーロッパ。
時代や関係性をもとに、自由に描いていただけると嬉しいです。
黒髪が怒りで金髪を傷つける場面、二人で銃を構えて敵に立ち向かう場面、または日常の一幕など、どのような構図でも大歓迎です。

個人観賞／壁紙／SNSアイコン
